standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the shifted sequence $0 \to \Omega^\bullet_{X/S}[1] \to \Omega^\bullet_{X/S}(\log Y)[1] \to \Omega^\bullet_{Y/S} \to 0$ whose boundary is the map $\delta$ of the statement.

standard_prerequisites.use: It defines $\xi'$ and $\zeta'$ as the maps attached to $c_1^{dR}(\mathcal{O}_X(-Y))$ and to its restriction to $Y$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The punctured line bundle sequence and the identification of its boundary with the Chern class map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, labels lemma-the-complex-for-L-star (invoked at proof lines 2608 and 2643) and lemma-the-complex-for-L-star-gives-chern-class (invoked at proof lines 2606 and 2641)
standard_prerequisites.use: They describe $\xi'$ and $\zeta'$ as boundary maps of the punctured line bundle sequences, which reduces the commutativity to producing morphisms of short exact sequences.

core_obligations: Define $\delta$ as the boundary map of the shifted log sequence and reduce the claim to the commutativity of each of the two triangles, setting $\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{O}_X(-Y)$ and writing $\pi : L \to X$ for the associated line bundle with $\pi_*\mathcal{O}_L = \bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathcal{L}^{\otimes n}$ (proof lines 2592-2602).

Upper left triangle: use the identification of $\xi'$ with the boundary of the punctured line bundle sequence, and by functoriality produce the morphism of short exact sequences whose middle arrow is $\omega' + \mathrm{d}\log(s)\wedge\omega \mapsto \omega' + \mathrm{d}\log(f)\wedge\omega$, where $s$ is a local generator of $\mathcal{L}$ and $f$ the corresponding section of the ideal sheaf of $Y$; the constructions in the two lemmas match, so this works (proof lines 2604-2636).

Lower right triangle: denote by $\overline{L}$ the restriction of $L$ to $Y$ and use the same identification for $\zeta'$ with the line bundle $\overline{L}$ on $Y$, then produce the morphism of short exact sequences whose middle arrow sends $\omega' + \mathrm{d}\log(f)\wedge\omega$ to $\omega'|_Y + \mathrm{d}\log(\overline{s})\wedge\omega|_Y$, again matching the two constructions (proof lines 2638-2673).
proof_roadmap: The boundary map and the reduction to two triangles (proof lines 2592-2602).
Commutativity of the upper left triangle (proof lines 2604-2636).
Commutativity of the lower right triangle (proof lines 2638-2673).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states the compatibility of the Gysin type boundary map of the log complex with the maps attached to the first Chern class of the divisor, as the commutativity of a square in the derived category (statement lines 2559-2590). The proof identifies both maps with boundaries of punctured line bundle sequences and, by functoriality, reduces the claim to exhibiting two morphisms of short exact sequences; the middle arrows are given by explicit formulas replacing the logarithmic derivative of a local generator by that of a defining equation of the divisor, the constructions of the two lemmas matching. The explicit comparison morphisms are the substance, so the claim is H2.
